# @xcvzlabs/env

> 标签: config, configuration, env, environment, environment-variables, runtime-agnostic, standard-schema, typescript, validation, validator

## 简介

Runtime-agnostic environment variable loader and validator built on Standard Schema — works with Zod, Valibot, ArkType, or any compliant validator.
